title: Secrets
description: API keys your agent's tools need. Encrypted, never readable, only replaceable.
usage: Name a secret in benchmark settings (auth_env: TAVILY_API_KEY). The agent never sees its value. Each run gets only the secrets it names.
agentUsage: Agents can set a variable to {{ref}}, and the agent can read it. A missing secret stops the run.
addDescription: Admins only. After saving, only the name shows.
name: Name
nameFormat: Upper case letters, digits and underscores, start with a letter, max 64.
nameTaken: Name exists. Replace its value instead.
valueTooLarge: The value is larger than 16 KiB.
emptyViewer: No secrets yet. Ask an admin.
confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Runs using it fail until re-added.
